scripts.dev:full: pnpm infra:up && sh -c 'trap "pnpm infra:down" EXIT INT TERM; pnpm dev'
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e .env -- dotnet watch --solution DocSign.slnx run --project apps/api/src/Api
scripts.gen:spec: dotenv -e .env -- dotnet build --solution DocSign.slnx apps/api/src/Api -c Debug
scripts.build: pnpm build:api && pnpm gen:types && pnpm build:web
scripts.lint: biome check . && dotenv -e .env -- dotnet format DocSign.slnx --verify-no-changes
scripts.format: biome check --write . && dotenv -e .env -- dotnet format DocSign.slnx
scripts.db:add: dotenv -e .env -- dotnet ef migrations add --project apps/api/src/Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/Api
scripts.db:migrate: dotnet ef database update --project apps/api/src/Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/Api
scripts.clean: dotenv -e .env -- dotnet clean DocSign.slnx && pnpm -r exec rimraf dist node_modules/.vite
